title: The Lord's Servant Becomes a Light for the Nations
keywords: salvation to the ends of the earth
description: The Lord's servant describes how the Lord called him from his mother's womb and made his mouth like a sharp sword. Although he has labored in vain, his reward is with God. The Lord expands the servant's mission from restoring the tribes of Jacob to becoming a light for the nations, so that salvation reaches to the ends of the earth. The deeply despised servant will be honored by kings and rulers, because of the Lord, the Holy One of Israel, who has chosen him [ref:Jes 49:1-7|Isaiah 49:1-7].
